phrases.text: Question 1 is about the register of probate, a county office in the state constitution.
Both the House and the Senate passed the amendment.
The amendment needs two-thirds of those voting on it to pass.
Today, the constitution lists registers of probate among elected county officers.
The voters' guide in the amendment says the duties of the office were redistributed to circuit court clerks in 2011.
If the amendment is adopted, the voters' guide says, the constitution will eliminate the position of register of probate.
New Hampshire's Questions on the General Election Ballot 2026 does not include a cost estimate for the amendment.
New Hampshire publishes no official argument for the amendment.
New Hampshire publishes no official argument against the amendment.
A yes vote removes the office from the constitution.
A no vote keeps the office of register of probate in the constitution.
